title: Exchange Engram's own task data on its public data branch and bootstrap DL560 from it
outcome: Exchange Engram's own task data on its public data branch and bootstrap DL560 from it
acceptance: Central's Engram store is opted in for task sync with Greg's quoted instruction, and the dedicated data worktree exists on the orphan engram-data branch; no code branch, index or master is touched
The first Central export has been checked before publication for secrets and private personal data, above all the user's email address; what was checked and found is recorded
The export is committed on engram-data and pushed to origin as a new branch or a fast-forward, with no force, rebase or rewrite; the commit, tree and push time are recorded
DL560 has an Engram store for github.com/grlap/Engram, bootstrapped from that branch by a dry run and then an empty-basis import with no task held or refused; its task count matches Central's export
The limits are recorded: notes off, and memories, claims, runs and evidence not transferred
